question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fewer**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fewer **is a comparative term used to indicate a smaller number of items or a diminished quantity. It is used when referring to countable nouns. (**कम संख्या या कम मात्रा**)

 
 
• **Example**: *There are fewer cars in the parking lot today.*
 
 
 
• ​In this given context, "**fewer**" is the correct word for the blank because it appropriately communicates the idea that the invention of more efficient machinery results in a decreased need for a larger number of hands or workers.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**More**" is a comparative term used to indicate a greater quantity or number of items. It is used when referring to countable or uncountable nouns. (**अधिक**)
 
• "**Many**" is an adjective used to describe a large or significant number of countable items. (**अनेक**)
 
• "**A lot of**" is a phrase that signifies a large or considerable quantity of something. (**बहुत ज़्यादा**)
